title: Four Ships at First Light
style: Cinematic painted key art for a modern real-time strategy game, the look of classic Command and Conquer box art: dramatic light, rich colour, crisp detail, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no letters, no flags, no insignia.

music.caption: epic naval cinematic underscore, deep brass swells, steady war drums, sea-wind pads, a hopeful horn theme at dawn, building to a final crescendo, no vocals

shots.prompt: Four large merchant cargo ships in a line approaching a narrow sea strait at first light, mountains on both shores, calm silver water, a sense of scale and fragility.
shots.line: Four merchant vessels are approaching the strait.

shots.prompt: Turn this top-down game map into a glowing holographic tactical map projected on a dark command table, seen at a slight angle. Keep the terrain layout, coastline and roads of the reference. Add three blue shipping lanes through the water, three red warning markers on the shore, a blue tower icon for Passage Control, teal and gold light.
shots.line: Their crews see the shipping lanes. Your command sees the gaps in the coastal picture.

shots.prompt: Engineers raising a modern radar tower and a technology centre on a coastal plateau at sunrise, cranes and trucks, sparks from welding, the strait below.
shots.line: Build the radar and technology network, and survey every sector.

shots.prompt: Grainy thermal reconnaissance footage from high above a rocky shoreline: two mobile missile launchers hidden among boulders near the water, targeting brackets, scan lines, a surveillance camera look.
shots.line: Mobile launchers are hiding along the shore. Find them before the ships arrive.

shots.prompt: Portrait of a fictional Saudi Arabian naval commander in his forties, neat black beard, navy uniform with a headset, standing in a dim harbour control room with radar screens behind him, calm and decisive, looking at the viewer, cinematic rim light, painted portrait.
shots.line: Hold Passage Control until the last vessel is through.

shots.prompt: The last cargo ship sailing out of the strait into the open sea at sunrise, patrol boats escorting it, golden light on the water, gulls, triumphant and calm.
shots.line: The lifeline ends where the open sea begins.
